title: Kiritani Haruka — Plotting A Surprise〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, we're this way.
Bye, Shiho! Bye, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: See you both.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, see you.
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're not going with them, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's somewhere I'd like to go before I head home.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, wanna walk part of the way together?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. By the way, the zoo was so much fun today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be honest, I was really surprised when you and Ichika showed up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Good. That means we succeeded.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't realize you were so mischievous.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Guilty.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Hinomori, which animals did you think were the cutest?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't decide. The leopard cat family was adorable, but I also couldn't believe how quickly that guinea pig fell asleep in my lap...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What about the rabbits at the petting zoo?
You seemed to enjoy them quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... They couldn't seem to get enough of the carrots and spinach I had, which was...well, really cute...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you had such a fun time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, that's enough about me.
How about you, Kiritani? Which animals did you like the most?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me...? I think I enjoyed all of us hanging out much more than any of the animals I saw today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All of us hanging out...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, true...
We don't really get to do stuff like this since we're all so busy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I hope we get to hang out again soon.
We could try going somewhere else next time... Oh, like an aquarium.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: An aquarium...? Yeah, that could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Aquariums have all sorts of cuddly creatures...like penguins.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You really like penguins, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I do. Getting to pet all those little critters made me want to pet some penguins too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does the aquarium let you do that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Only during special events they hold occasionally.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And you get to touch them...?
Now I'm really curious.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we go together the next time they hold one of those events, Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I want—
I mean, if I'm free...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time... I'm a little worried about how you're going to react.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To what?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is, in the face of real-life penguins... I sort of lose sight of everything else.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can get tunnel vision like that, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, and if they all flock towards me...
Well, something embarrassing might happen.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I kinda want to see that now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, even for an event, I doubt they'd let you play with a whole flock of penguins all at once. Not unless you're actually taking care of them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As part of the aquarium staff...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How could I've been so oblivious? I might have to see if they'll let us shadow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I was kidding.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In any case, I'm going to go sate my penguin craving in a different way today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A different way?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was thinking about stopping by the Penguin Cafe. They don't have real penguins, but the atmosphere should be more than enough.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that's what you were talking about going before you head home...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Seeing all those cute little animals today made me want to cap off the day by seeing some penguins.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see. Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I won some penguin merch in a prize draw that one time, and I'm pretty sure it said online that the Penguin Cafe has new stuff from that brand...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you like to come with me, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I... I guess their menu's probably changed since the last time I went, so it might be nice to go back again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, I wanna see what happens to you when you're surrounded by penguins.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I should be fine...
But please stop me if I start losing control.
